Usage: tool <command> [flags]

tool keeps a registry of repositories in step.

A registry of repositories kept in step.

  Indented lines stay as written.

Flags:
  -h, --help         Show context-sensitive help.
      --json         Print one JSON object instead of text.
      --home=HOME    Root of the registry (default: ~/.local/state/tool; env: $CLIKIT_TEST_HOME).

Commands:
  list                       List the registered repositories.
  repo add <path>            Register a repository by its path.
  repo remove <names> ...    Forget repositories; their files stay.
  settle (--keep=MACHINE | --delete) <target>
                             Settle a file both machines changed.
  fail <how>                 Fail the way <how> says.
  echo                       Copy stdin to stdout.

Output:
  --json prints one object; text otherwise.

Examples:
  tool list
  tool repo add ~/dev/gwt

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  5    done, but some repositories need attention

Run "tool <command> --help" for a command's details.
